text:
morgan: Hey everyone — I've addressed the comments on PR #4282 and pushed an updated branch. PTAL when you have a minute. Summary: split large change into two commits, added unit test for allocator rotation, tightened the kv-allocator lock, updated README migration notes, and added a small migration helper under tools/compat. CI passed locally but GitHub actions is still running.
kevin: Thanks — I'll take a look in ~1h. Quick question: did you add a migration note for clusters that still use the old shard config format?
morgan: Yes — added a short paragraph in README.md (under "Upgrading shard configs") and an integration test that exercises the fallback path. The helper script is tools/compat/migrate_shard_config.py.
anya: PTAL — quick pass from me: tests look good, and the new unit covers the rotation case nicely. One nit: in allocator.go L204, prefer atomic.AddInt64 for the counter instead of the extra mutex you added. Not blocking.
morgan: Good catch, thanks — swapped to atomic.AddInt64 and pushed a fix. I squashed that into the feature commit to keep history tidy.
ci-bot: github-actions: build/test passed for commit a1b2c3 (PR #4282) :white_check_mark:
kevin: LGTM from me pending one more SRE/perf eye for regression risk. @lin can you glance at the perf side? If no objections I can merge after we reserve a canary slot.
lin: I'll run a short perf run on staging (10k qps warmup) and report back in ~20m.
deploy-bot: canary-scheduler: reserved canary slot 2026-03-18T13:40Z for PR #4282.
lin: Ran the quick perf run — tail latency looks stable, p90 improved ~3%, no regressions observed. Attached basic graphs in the PR. :thumbsup:
kevin: Great — since Morgan already squashed the small fix, are we good to merge after I grab the canary slot? Morgan, do you want history preserved or squash-only?
morgan: Squashed already per earlier note. Please merge when ready. Thanks! :)
